state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. The macro's doc says how a card
is written. The ten lexer codes `E0001`–`E0010` carry cards. Every other code is in the test
module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed`
holds the two together both ways.

`nvs agent index` prints a carded code as `code: E0007  <first sentence>`, and `show E0007` prints the
line and then the whole card (`crates/nvs-cli/src/agent/names.rs`, `codes()` and `first_sentence`).
The acceptance check's second test, `no_code_still_owes_a_card`, does not exist yet. It lands in the
session that empties the list, because it fails until then. Stage 5 is not started.

items.text: **The terminal rendering names `nvs agent show <code>` once** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; `Renderer::render_all` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/render.rs:255` writes the closing summary, and its one caller is `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:3400`. The trap: 466 `.nvst` cases end their `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block with the literal `error: aborting due to N errors`, and `format_matches` at `crates/nvs-test/src/expect.rs:108` matches the whole output, so a new last line breaks every one of them. Decide first whether the conformance runner renders through `render_all`. If it does, give `Renderer` an opt-in for the line that only the CLI turns on. If it runs the binary, append the new literal line to those cases with one script. Pin the line in `summary_counts_errors_and_warnings` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/render.rs:482`, and cover the warnings-only run at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/render.rs:502`.

**Drain the list, one band per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the parser band starts at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:192`. A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above the code and the site that raises it, never only the constant's name. Delete each code from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in the same commit. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside the list at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4090` in the session that deletes the last entry from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, as an assertion that the list is empty.
